title: One Residual with Three Reuses: A Wristband Front End for Gesture Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2608.16542v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continuous wrist-worn hand sensing for gesture interfaces and motor symptom monitoring needs an always-on front end that fits inside a coin-cell power budget while pairing a micro-electro-mechanical-systems (MEMS) inertial measurement unit (IMU) with a 60 GHz frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar to stay robust under occlusion and on-body drift. We present a design study of such a wristband front end in which classifier wake-up gating, mmWave versus IMU routing, and innovation-based EKF measurement reweighting share a single on-chip residual generator. The shared generator occupies 14.4 KB of program memory and 278 B of state and runs at 110K multiply-accumulates (MACs) per frame on an Ambiq Apollo4 Blue Plus class edge microcontroller unit (MCU). Across four public sensor data corpora (IPN Hand, SHREC 2021, MiliPoint 60 GHz FMCW radar, EAT-Radar) the front end reaches detection probability $P_D = 0.72/0.80$ at a 1% false-alar

translated_title: 一个残差，三次复用：用于手势感知的腕带前端
translated_abstract: 面向手势界面和运动症状监测的连续腕戴式手部感知，需要一个始终在线的、适应纽扣电池功耗预算的前端，同时将微机电系统（MEMS）惯性测量单元（IMU）与60 GHz调频连续波（FMCW）雷达配对，以在遮挡和身体漂移下保持鲁棒性。我们展示了此类腕带前端的设计研究，其中分类器唤醒门控、毫米波与IMU路由选择以及基于创新的扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）测量重新加权，共享一个片上的残差生成器。该共享生成器占用14.4 KB程序内存和278 B状态，在Ambiq Apollo4 Blue Plus级别的边缘微控制器单元（MCU）上以每帧110K乘法累加运算（MACs）运行。在四个公共传感器数据语料库（IPN Hand、SHREC 2021、MiliPoint 60 GHz FMCW雷达、EAT-Radar）上，该前端在1%误警率下达到检测概率 \(P_D = 0.72/0.80\)。
tldr: 本研究提出一种腕带前端，通过单个共享残差生成器复用三种功能（唤醒门控、路由选择和EKF加权），在超低功耗边缘MCU上实现高效鲁棒的手势感知，并在多个公开数据集上验证了性能。
en_tdlr: This study presents a wristband front end that reuses a single residual generator for three functions (wake-up gating, routing, and EKF reweighting), enabling efficient and robust gesture sensing on an ultra-low-power edge MCU, validated across multiple public datasets.
